title: Return-Refund Reimbursement Schedule of the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee
content:
Claims adjustment schedule of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee: the return-refund reimbursement.

**1. Claim and scope.** This policy fixes the return-refund reimbursement, the amount Northgate pays when it grants a return-not-refunded guarantee claim; the claim handled is the order's most recent return-not-refunded claim whose claim record shows no decision yet (where two such entries share a date, the one recorded first counts), and its claimed line, claimed units and claimed amount are the ones that claim records. The policy applies only where the order is of a seller program other than Fulfilled by Northgate, was paid with an external card and carries no more than ten lines, the claimed line carries exactly one return request, and the order carries exactly one return-not-refunded claim whose claim record shows no decision, and the seller has not refunded every claimed unit; elsewhere it fixes nothing, its figure is zero and the base rule stands: "A granted claim reimburses the price paid for the affected items plus their shipping, less everything the seller already refunded on them, capped at the program's guarantee maximum per order across all claims on the order, rounded half up to the cent and paid to the original payment."

**2. The request and the line.** The return request behind that claim is the most recent return request recorded on the claimed line (where two such entries share a date, the one recorded first counts), with the reason and request date that request records. The claimed line's set price per unit is its line amount divided by the units bought on it, and the price paid for the claimed units is that set price per unit times the claimed units; the units of the claimed line still held are the units bought on it less the units asked back on it by change-of-mind return requests. The refunds already received on the claimed units are every unit refund entry recorded on the line, an entry that refunds no units not being a unit refund; they are taken from the return-refund reimbursement, and the units of the line refunded are counted the same way. The order's merchandise total is the sum of its line amounts and the order's units are the units bought across its lines.

**3. Amount.** The return-refund reimbursement is the merchandise value of the claimed units, taken as the listed unit price of their line times the claimed units, plus their shipping portion, taken as the order's whole shipping charge, less the refunds already received.

**4. Room and limit.** The guarantee room for a return-not-refunded claim is the program's guarantee maximum per order, less every guarantee reimbursement already booked on the order, less the amounts claimed on the order's other claims whose claim record shows no decision yet, a decision on a claim being shown on its claim record as well as on its decision entry. Every amount added to or taken from the return-refund reimbursement enters it before the limit to the guarantee room is applied. The return-refund reimbursement is limited to that guarantee room and never falls below zero, and only that final figure is rounded half up to the cent.

**Hypothetical worked case.** A Northgate Marketplace Pro Seller order paid by external card has a line of 3 units listed at USD 80.00 with a line amount of 240.00 and a shipping charge of 9.00; the claim covers 1 unit and nothing has been refunded. The reimbursement is 80.00 plus 9.00, that is 89.00. The claim's own amount claimed is not counted against the room; if another claim on the order with no decision yet claimed 2450.00, the room is 2500.00 less 2450.00, that is 50.00, and the reimbursement is limited to 50.00.
